say:1:1623467001:1.text: Olaya? What are you doing here?
say:1:1623467001:1.source_cn: 奥莱雅？你怎么会在这里？

say:3:1623467003:1.text: She avoids eye contact instinctively. It's nothing like the sharp, confident Olaya everyone knows.
say:3:1623467003:1.source_cn: 她下意识地避开了目光接触，这与平日那个锋芒毕露的她判若两人。

say:4:1623467004:1.text: Bel asked you to come, didn't he? People won't stop talking about you.
say:4:1623467004:1.source_cn: 是巴布邀请你来的吧？我听到很多学生在讨论你。

say:5:1623467005:1.text: Yeah. He invited me... and next time I'm supposed to go on as a guest.
say:5:1623467005:1.source_cn: 嗯，是巴布邀请我的……下一次研讨会，我会作为嘉宾出席。

say:6:1623467006:1.text: You know his article's got a lot of made-up stuff in it. Why would you go along with this?
say:6:1623467006:1.source_cn: 你明明知道巴布的报道有很多虚构成分，为什么还要来？

choice_prompt:7:1623467006.text: You know his article's got a lot of made-up stuff in it. Why would you go along with this?
choice_prompt:7:1623467006.source_cn: 你明明知道巴布的报道有很多虚构成分，为什么还要来？

say:8:1623467007:1.text: You're still the same, Reeo. Always lecturing the first chance you get... Yeah, they messed up. But they already paid for it, and it wasn't some slap on the wrist. It's the kind of punishment that can ruin a life.
say:8:1623467007:1.source_cn: 你还是老样子，满口大道理……这些学生确实犯了错，但他们...

say:9:1623467008:1.text: One greedy mistake and you're done with magic forever? Even Zorya—and you know how strict she is—wouldn't call that fair.
say:9:1623467008:1.source_cn: 一次贪欲的后果就是赔上终生的魔法生涯？即便是以严格要求...

say:10:1623467009:1.text: They lost their magic. They lost everyone's trust. Now they're getting turned into a headline for people to laugh at. And they're still students, Reeo. Same as us. They haven't even finished school yet.
say:10:1623467009:1.source_cn: 他们损失了魔法能力，也失去了周围同学的信任，还被当成新...

say:11:1623467010:1.text: When someone's going under, they hold onto whatever they can reach. You of all people should get that.
say:11:1623467010:1.source_cn: 在水里挣扎的人总会想抓住目所能及的浮木，你该理解这种心情。

say:12:1623467011:1.text: Olaya, whatever they're holding onto, it's not real! And Bel's article is only going to make it worse. People are already starting to blame the school and magic itself. If this keeps going, we'll be tearing up our own foundations!
say:12:1623467011:1.source_cn: 奥莱雅，这根“浮木”是假的！巴布的那篇文章只会让情况更...

say:13:1623467012:1.text: And if they have nothing to hold onto, some of them won't make it through. Even if what they're holding onto isn't real...
say:13:1623467012:1.source_cn: 但如果连一点希望都没有，他们可能会撑不下去，哪怕这“希...

say:14:1623467013:1.text: Olaya, you know better than any of us.
say:14:1623467013:1.source_cn: 奥莱雅，你比我们都清楚。

say:15:1623467014:2.text: The only way out is to get them to remember why they loved magic in the first place. Those were your words.
say:15:1623467014:2.source_cn: 唯一的出路是让他们想起自己最初为何热爱魔法——这句话，...

say:16:1623467015:2.text: Olaya freezes. She opens her mouth like she's about to snap back, then nothing comes out. She looks down instead, fingers twisting the edge of her sleeve.
say:16:1623467015:2.source_cn: 奥莱雅愣住了，她张了张嘴，最终只是沉默地低下头，手指无...

say:19:1623467016:0.text: Right then, the host's voice carries across the plaza.
say:19:1623467016:0.source_cn: 而此时，主持人的声音传遍广场。

say:20:1623467017:1.source_cn: 各位请安静，研讨会即将开始！
